translation.name: GOD ETER AGERKE NAMDERASEM TUMA YENBO

book.name: LUK
book.title: LUK Luk ere basem Tuma Yenbo. Kiyi late tuma.

content: Jisas ere sele meike sene wayen yim.
Kwokwos ei berabetemke, ta eme emri kiyi eyarem kwar peten sen selek yim.
Yin lam, sele mei ragerem pape ere sele mei ganke temenem.
Etep lam, eme yin wurin eme Aneyen eri kupa lawoyim.
Lawoyim, eme ep abo ep abom, eme eiksekapke tem. Eiksekap tem, agetage eme lam, tame pes, epri tame oub geipasubuwai labetem, epe mekinke yan tetemenem.
Tetemenem, ta eme etep lan aken selke warem. Selke warem, tame pes epe emne etep wom. Beke kem wouken tame erne sa tame etemri emik sopbe?
Ere gwotek beke te. Ere sene wayen yiwo. Kem ek met. Kiyi ere Galilike temenem, ere kemne etep wom.
An Tatame Etemne Lan Yeirim Tame, eme ane tame yaper etepke newote, eme ane mek kwuran kwanen, an ek sate. Sate, yabel mur tetek, an sene wayen yite.
Etep womke, eme Jisas eri kiyi wom tuma sene abopitem,
eme sele mei mesginin sene yan ep yekwo let ep yekwo let tewo ges wuri keyem (11-pela) tame emne akeite tameken emne emri lam wos emne wusowum.
Wusowum ta eme Makdala komri Maria te gwo, Joana te gwo, Jems eteri nawo Maria te gwo. Etem, kau taken etem etep temenem, eme Aposel tame emne ete tuma wusowum.
Wusowum, Aposel tame eme etep abom. Ta eme tuma bepou me yikwokwobe. Etep abom, eme emri tuma kenawaike beke met.

Etep tem, Pita ere wayen teten sele meike amen yim. Yim, ere gwuromun nerewurin lam, Jisas eteri matewou sele meike temenem. Etepwou temenem, ere akek sene yibetem, eri lam wosken eri metem tumaken ere ep abo ep abom.
Tame pes epe Jisas erne Emeus keluke lam.
Ete yabelke tame pes epe etemri tame tep Jerusalem gene kerak tetan kom nebulek yibetem. Kom sig e Emeus.
Yibetem, Jisas eterne pem tuma epe eteke namden yibetem.
Namden yibetem, Jisas ere yan epne semowun etepken kir yibetem.
Eme ete tuma namden yibetem, epe Jisas erne lam, epe erne beke noub la.
Epe noub beke la, ere epne etep wom. Kep yibe, kep be tumake namdebe? Etep womke, epe pap yaper meten makemake ten tetem.
Makemake ten tetem, tame wuri, eri sig Kliopas, ere awosein etep wom. Ete kom tame nogwape eme yan Jerusalemke tetan, yekik tem wos eme kir lam. Nerenwou yekik tem wos ne beke la o ne beke met.

Jisas ere etep wometem. Be woske tem? Epe sene etep wom. Nasaret komri Jisas eterne eme pemkap, nesa eteke namdebe. Ere yaku eisau kerebetem, nemne tuma yenbo wosoubetem. God eter, tatame etem eme erne tame yenbo wom.
God eri akeri apeilake, nemri apeilake eme erne apeilake Pailat eterne panen yin tuma namdem, eme erne pen sate namderasem. Namderasem, eme erne mek kwuran kwanem.
Ete tame, kiyi nema etep abom. Kap tame ere Israel tatame emri apeilake ten emri peiktame emne teitkwunte. Etep abom. Eme erne yekik pem, gwopte yabel mur woye.
Gwopte nema nemri ta kau emri woye tuma metye, nema wouken akye. Ei berabeteyek, eme selek yiwo,
eme Jisas eri kupa lawoiwo. Lawoiwo, eme sene yan nemne etep woye. Nema God eri kom tame pes laye. Epe nemne etep woye. Jisas ere wou sene petye. Ete ta epe etep woye.
Etep woye, nemri tame tep eme selek yiwo, eme ete ta epri woye wos laye. Eterne eme beke la. Etep wom.
Jisas ere epne etep wom. Kep porere berai. Kiyiri tuma wusoubetem tame emri tuma kep beke abo.
Kap kep beke met, Krais, God eter won yam tame, ere mus kiyi mette, yuri ere kom yenbok sene yin tete. Etepkap ete tuma ere sekenwai tem.
Etep wom, Jisas ere Moses eri bas rasem tuma etek tasen, God eteri kiyiri tuma wusoubetem tame etem bas rasem tumaken ere epne noub maime wusowum.
Eme yin emri kom mekin mekinmenem, Jisas ere keranabu kere yite wom.
Sene yite wom, epe erne wotaken etep wom. Ne nesetken gwotek tete. Yabel warbe, neir teketen yabe. Ere wurin etepken tem.
Ten eme a ate wom, Jisas ere etepken sin ere bret peten God erne pir won pekayewon epne newom.
Newom, epe erne kuyese noub lam. Lam, ere agetage etek pekan yim.
Pekan yim, epe etepwou etepwou kena namden etep wom. Nema keluke yawo, ere nesetne God eri basem tuma somo nesne wusouye, nesetri pap yenbo metye. Epe etep wom.
Epe agetage Jerusalemke sene yim. Yin lam, ep yekwo let ep yekwo let tewo ges wuri keyem (11-pela) anepoi tame, akeite tameken eme wurisubuk simenem.
Simenem, eme etep wom. Sekenwai. Aneyen ere selek sene wayewo. Saimon ere erne laye.
Etep womke, epe emne ete tuma wusowum. Epe Jisas erne keluke lan akek panen yim, ere bret peten pekayewomke, epe erne etek noub lam, epe emne etep wusowum.
Anepoi tame eme Jisas erne lam.
Epe emne ete tuma wusobetemke, eme lam, Jisas ere etemri borborke me pamnen ere emne pir wom.
Pir wom, eme wouken akem, eme etep abom. Kap nema gaboke labe.
Ere emne etep wom. Beke kem ep abo ep abobe? Beke kem pap pes teye?
Kem ek la. Ari letken tewoken kem la. Gwo aren. Kem ane let kerelate. Ek la. An wusomken. Gabo etem eme wusomken berai.
Etep womke, ere eri letken tewoken emne peteram.
Peteram, eme bepou me metekwasem, eme erne kenawaike beke noub abo, eme ep abo ep abobetem. Kap Jisas eter o? Etep ten ere emne eke wolam. Kem awos tetan o?
Eme erne emri lisem omyen tep newom,
ere peten etemri bitimik am.

Ere emne etep wom. Kiyi an keremken temenem, an kemne ete tuma wusoubetem. An etep wom. Tuma nogwape eme kiyi basem, ete tuma ere sekenwai tete. Moses eteri siglouri tuma, Devit eteri siglouri tuma e yuri sekenwai tete.
Etep womke, eme meten God eri basem tuma noub metem.
Noub metem, ere emne etep wom. Siglouri tuma etep wobe. Krais, God eter yaku newom tame ere mus eisau mette, yabel mur tete, ere sene wayete.
Sene wayete, tatame eme Krais eteri murek tuma wusoute. Eme Jerusalemke kiyi wusoutek, yuri eme kom nogwapeke yin etep kir wosoute. Kem kemri wule yaper mesgintek, God ere kemne ek gerute.
Kem lam woskap kem etepke yin wusoute.
Apei ere kiyi kemne newote namderasem wos an kemne newote. Kem gwote kom sagke koute, ete mure ere Heven mesginin keremne yate. Jisas ere etep wom.
God ere Jisas erne womke, ere eteri kom Hevenke sene yim.
Ere etep womke, ere emne Betani kom mekinke panen yim, ere eri let nenewayen tuma yenbo wom.
Tuma yenbo emne wobetem, God ere erne peten ere God eteri kom Hevenke yim.
Yim, eme eri sig eisau wom, eme letewo oksubuwai ten eme Jerusalemke sene yim.
Yim, kwokwos kwokwos eme God eri ake eisauke yin wurin God erne pir won erne tuma yenbo wobetem. Luk ere bas rasem tuma ere ab eteke.
